meta.caveat: The eBL release (Zenodo 10018951) does not state the sign-list revision used to compute its signs field; this table is eBL's sign list as fetched, so a renumbering between release and fetch is possible. tools/check_sign_map.py measures agreement with the release itself.

ebl.rights: eBL sign list (LMU Munich); facts only (sign name, list number, code points, value list) are kept here.

meta.what: ABZ sign-list numbers used by the eBL release, mapped to Unicode cuneiform through eBL's own sign list, cross-checked against ORACC OSL. Glyphs are standardized Unicode characters, not the tablet's handwriting.
